subject: Request: Additional outreach credits for BridgeLearning research extension
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@edu-ngo.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edu-ngo.org
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Additional outreach credits for BridgeLearning research extension

Hi Ben and Marissa,

Thanks again for supporting BridgeLearning's pilot. Our semester extension was approved, but the research team unexpectedly ran through our initial credit allotment testing multilingual transcript anonymization and a broader set of prompts for teacher-assist tools. We have a small gap to finish the work for this grant application (final reports due April 20).

Can Redwood provide a one-time top-up of credits or a short trial extension (2–3 weeks) to cover roughly 150k tokens (~$1.2k estimated)? I attached the pilot usage breakdown and our revised budget for transparency. If you need a formal letter for procurement, happy to provide.

Attachments: pilot-usage-report.pdf (3 pages, usage by model) | educational_budget.xlsx (requested funding lines)

Best,
Amina Yusuf
Director of Research Programs
BridgeLearning Initiative
amina.yusuf@edu-ngo.org
+44 7700 900123
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@edu-ngo.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:00:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Additional outreach credits for BridgeLearning research extension

Thanks for the clear breakdown, Amina — and congrats on the extension. Quick clarifying questions so I can expedite this internally:

- Is the 150k-token estimate peak or total remaining usage across models?
- Will any new data be uploaded that requires different retention/segmentation?
- Are we still within the same academic grant funding lines (no PO change)?

Marissa, looping you in for approvals/discount guidance — this is the BridgeLearning pilot (DEAL-8472). If we can confirm the ask and there's no PO change, I can request a one-time promotional credit from CS. Monica — can you advise on typical top-up sizes for academic/community pilots and whether we should convert this to a promo code vs applying credits on the account?

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dr. Amina Yusuf <amina.yusuf@edu-ngo.org>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Additional outreach credits for BridgeLearning research extension

Hi Amina — and hi Ben/Monica,

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the attached usage report; the higher token consumption is primarily from a larger input set for transcript anonymization (makes sense given the extra classrooms). From a PLG / EDU outreach perspective, I'd be comfortable approving a one-time 150k-token promo credit tied to the account (no billing adjustment), with these conditions:

- Promo valid for 21 days from application date
- For research-only usage (no commercial redistribution)
- We ask BridgeLearning to complete a short impact survey after the extension (2–3 questions)

Amina — if that's acceptable, I'll ask Monica to apply the credit and set the expiry. Ben, please add the HubSpot note (DEAL-8472) and mark as "promo approved".

Marissa
Program Lead, Education Initiatives
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Approved. I applied a one-time promo credit of 150,000 tokens to BridgeLearning's account (account id: BL-3921). Promo code applied as an account credit and configured to expire 21 days after application. No billing changes required.

Notes:
- Promo reference: PROMO-EDU-2026-04
- Applied by: Monica Patel (Customer Success)
- HubSpot updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/582901/DEAL-8472 (note: "promo approved")
- Support ticket created for audit: SUP-3921 (https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3921)

Amina — happy to extend the window further if the team runs into edge cases; please complete the short survey Marissa mentioned after you wind down. If procurement needs a confirmation letter, Ben can send a brief statement that credits were applied and are a one-time goodwill allocation.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
